items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 89:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva, that she is always the back of ZA? Every lower one is discerned as the back of its upper, because it does not receive from the face of the upper but from its aspect of the back, as said in the previous parts. And therefore the Nukva, who is a lower to ZA, is always discerned as his back. (Item 76).
